items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One of them went with Sara, my cousin.

ctx.x: I just remember him more as a bandleader who played for a long time, because when I was looking back at that era, I know he was playing in the late teens and he was still playing by the late ’20s and early ’30s. It was pretty much fading out then, the whole thing on the river, but he was like an institution. There were others, but that’s the one name that I remember.
I remember that they stayed at my house, some people in that band. We welcomed them. One of them went with Sara, my cousin.
